quests.title: A Lighthearted Feast of Magic!

dialogue.t: Hey... Yah!
My head's already full of music — dance, dance!
Sway, sway~
So happy~
Krraaa!
Made some extra money too.
Huh? Since when?
Nusta was swamped, so I helped out her trainees and cleared out a few monster nests.
In Natlan, fighting and dancing are equally exhilarating. I like it.
Thanks for that, Marine. I wanted the rookies to get more training, but they still couldn't handle that mission on their own.
I'll make them train harder when we get back!
No need — they did great. Just didn't expect the nest to have seven times the estimated number of monsters.
And the Flower-Feather Clan pays pretty well. I even saved enough to get a gift for Aeval.
But your vacation's about over too, right?
A few more days, then I'll start thinking about booking the return ship.
No rush, we can still dance. Roxane, Letellier, Chenee, and Frejus have all been competing for jobs lately, so I won't steal their thunder.
Then let's just keep dancing and keep having fun!
When you're tired, eat. When you're full, sleep. No worries at all!
Raargh!

dialogue.sit: The Melusines and the little Koholasaurus lined up and bounced their way toward the stage.

dialogue.t: What a lovely group of guests...
Hehe, looks like you're enjoying yourself too, Nusta.

dialogue.sit: Your smile looks so much more relaxed now.
And you even look a bit younger somehow.

dialogue.t: Really? Then I suppose I must attend every dance party from now on.
I'll make sure those kiddos who call me "ma'am" or even "auntie"... will one day realize I'm younger than them in spirit!
And I believe future dance parties should be just like this one — if anything, they should happen more often! I'm all for making it a monthly tradition!

quests.description: As another dance party draws to a close, everyone seems to have gained something wonderful…
